title: Good Night, Olympiacos 🌙 A Bedtime Football Story · Counting Stars
description:
A gentle bedtime story for little Olympiacos fans: the big European nights, the floodlights switching off one by one, and counting the club's legends like stars until the eyes close. Slow, calm and quiet — made for falling asleep.

Every date, score and name in the story is checked against the FAN LIFE archive and public records (UEFA, club histories).
